claim_boundary: This is a one-source-control function-aware PQ discriminator. It projects global lookup-table code bytes and measures the resulting PLE injection distortion for one sealed BOS input, but it does not materialize codes or residual records for the table, establish lookup coverage/semantics, execute a native compact path, prove broader PLE state behavior, close whole-NR EBPW, measure TPS, or preserve capability.

global_training_sample.source_reads: deterministic BF16 range reads only; no full lookup tensor is loaded

next: Reject uniformly shared PQ if its PLE-output curve remains dominated. Escalate only a surviving non-uniform/generative or protected-repair composition to additional disjoint source controls; do not treat active rows or projected codes as a materialized complete representation.

representation.base: global shared BF16 PQ codebooks with projected packed per-row codes plus optional fixed sparse repair

billed.sparse_repair: fixed per-row source-BF16 values plus packed offsets are projected and billed

representation.function_control: one sealed source PLE BOS injection checked by the reference oracle
representation.training: deterministic train-only rows from every source n-gram shard
